recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-16783 unless a separate reconciliation chooses to audit the closely related FHIR-16833 request.
issue_request: FHIR-16783 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CQI change request asking to align Measure criteria with the dynamic language pattern; its resolution was to update Measure to use the new Expression data type.
initial_application: The request was applied in SVN 14046, represented by git commit e169985949ad77cfed6c6e86ee8036a90f98136e, which cites GF#16833/GF#16783 and changed Measure criteria definitions and examples from string/path-style forms to Expression. The current source was later regenerated as source/measure/structuredefinition-Measure.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Measure in active build scope. Current Measure population, stratifier, stratifier component, and supplementalData criteria elements are typed as Expression, and current Measure examples do not use the old <criteria value=.../> pattern. FHIR-16833 is the same change family but was not decided in this seed reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because the current FHIR-core source already reflects the Jira decision.
